comment: Great teacher. Really cares about his students, and is a funny guy. Requires a lot of participation though in class.

Leads amazing class discussions & is really helpful outside of class. However, he thinks his class is the most important thing you will ever do & participation is 30% of the overall grade.  Be prepared to spend a fortune on books and endless hours reading through them.
Worst teacher at Richmond. If it weren't for the comfortable chairs in the class, I don't think I would've lasted through the year. Would've dropped the class the first day if I was allowed.
nom nom nom

I have Woody right now, and I think he's the****. We've had many a disagreement on how he grades, but if you do your work and PARTICIPATE, you'll get an acceptable grade. He has a pretty abrasive persona which is probably why everyone says he's a jerk, but I'd vote for him. Plus he's SAAAAMOOOKINN!!!

I don't even have words for the man...  Double standards in grading.  Will tell you how well you write during all your preliminary work for an assignment, then totally screws you over on the final product.  His directions are unclear and can change at a moment's notice without him telling you he ever changed them. oh and his quizzes are BS.

Holton is a true scholar and demands an effort on your part to become one. After all, that is why you're studying history at UR. His informal method for discussions in no way means you will not benefit greatly from them. Do the readings but also come with your own insights and criticisms, and you will be rewarded intellectually and gradewise.

Overall, really nice guy. Made the mistake of taking a really random class with him though. He knows his stuff REALLY well, so be careful when you say things. Readings are very boring and long. Discussions are essential so make sure you speak a lot. Knowing him outside of class is a lot better than inside. He's goofy, but a good teacher overall.

a lot of reading in this class, expects you to participate-affects your grade if you don't. 3 major papers (makes up the majority of your grade), the longest was 12 pages (others were 6), replies to emails late. no mid-terms or finals

i absolutely loved dr. holton. there is a lot of reading but you learn soooo much. definitely do the reading and he will love you. i got an A on everything i did in the class because i participated and asked him questions. get to know him outside of class and he'll love you. definitely take one of his history classes.

Woody Holton is hilarious. His class was never boring even though the reading always is. And there was a lot of reading and writing in this class. He isn't an exceptionally hard grader but he does expect you to write well and with NO typos. If you do well on the first paper your grade will be fine on all the rest.

The guy is ridiculous.  Funny sense of humor, but that's all that's going for him.  Ridiculously hard to write for, and some of the things he says make you think he came out of the 60's...which he probably did.
Great guy.  Really cares about his students.  He can be confused and biased though so watch out.
awful

He is the nutty professor.  The goofiest dressed professor on campus.  His attire is a foreshadowing of his craziness inside the classroom.  He is clearly biased against people with money.  Core class him was confusing and over analytical.  He is one of the most difficult profesors to write for.

so unorganized and unprofessional. drived me crazy. unlcear about assignments and what he wants on essays. does not return emails and does not give concrete help with "think pieces".try to be original, almost to the point of absurdity-participat
No Comments

The cool, libral, skatterbrained teacher.  While a tough grader, I was proud of work done for his class b/c it forced me to think and write well- the whole point of college.  He supports student groups & eats at dhall, what other profs do this??
He's a nice guy, but a pain in the a** grader.  He is disorganized, but helpful.  All in all, his teaching is a mixed bag.

(gone till fall 2005) crazy core class that had no foundation and crazy discussions.  i know you cant change your core professor, but i just want you to know what you are in store for...oh yeah, those crazy essays are think pieces...originality sux!!!

This guy has no clue.  His class is disorganized, boring, and always against the mainstream.  He rambles on about personal opinions rarely based on facts.  Also, he gives little to no guidance with regards to work.
